nodes.name: Payment initiation
nodes.description: Receives an outbound cross-border payment instruction.

nodes.name: Message validation
nodes.description: Validates required payment fields and formatting.

nodes.name: Sanctions screening
nodes.description: Screens parties and relevant payment attributes.

nodes.name: Fraud and limit checks
nodes.description: Applies transaction-risk and limit checks.

nodes.name: Dual authorization
nodes.description: Requires maker-checker approval before release.

nodes.name: Message transformation
nodes.description: Maps the canonical payment object to outbound message format.

nodes.name: Network dispatch
nodes.description: Sends the approved payment to the external messaging/network interface.

nodes.name: Exception and repair
nodes.description: Handles rejected, held, or malformed payments.

nodes.name: Nostro and GL reconciliation
nodes.description: Reconciles dispatched/settled payments to accounting records.

nodes.name: Payments reporting
nodes.description: Produces operational and management reporting.

nodes.name: Payment Orchestration Platform
nodes.description: Canonical payment-processing application.

nodes.name: Payment Validation Service
nodes.description: Executes message and business validation rules.

nodes.name: Screening Engine
nodes.description: Sanctions/watchlist screening application.

nodes.name: Transaction Risk Engine
nodes.description: Fraud and transaction-limit decision service.

nodes.name: Authorization Service
nodes.description: Stores and enforces payment approvals.

nodes.name: Message Transformation Service
nodes.description: Transforms canonical data into outbound payment messages.

nodes.name: Reconciliation Platform
nodes.description: Matches payment/network/accounting records.

nodes.name: Payments Reporting Mart
nodes.description: Produces payment operations reports.

nodes.name: Initiation API
nodes.description: Inbound interface to Payment Orchestration Platform.

nodes.name: Screening request interface
nodes.description: Sends payment-party data to Screening Engine.

nodes.name: Outbound CBPR+ interface
nodes.description: Dispatch boundary for outbound cross-border payment messages.

nodes.name: Settlement status feed
nodes.description: Returns acknowledgements and settlement status.

nodes.name: Ledger posting feed
nodes.description: Supplies payment accounting entries for reconciliation.
